content.title: Polish gunman kills six in Krakow main square
content.caption: A gunman suspected of ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland. At least six people were killed and several others injured.

slides.heading: Krakow, Poland
slides.text: A gunman killed six people in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland.

slides.heading: Attack Details
slides.text: The attack began in the Main Market Square, a bustling central point of the city. Police said a man drove into the square before beginning to fire at random people from his car.

slides.heading: Victims and Injuries
slides.text: Six people were confirmed dead, including a foreign national. Sixteen people were taken to hospital, including two police officers who were shot while detaining the attacker.
